The decisive mistake was made by Verification_Expert at step 1. The task was to verify the ticket and season pass prices. Verification_Expert could not access external sources, so it only checked that the given figures ($60 daily, $120 season pass) fell within a plausible historical range. It then declared them "verified" and computed savings of $120. The correct answer is $55, so the supplied prices were wrong and were never actually checked. The later agents (steps 3 and 5) only repeated this unverified conclusion.
